_doc: DERIVED. One feature per power holding two or more atlas regions, geometry dissolved from those regions, with holder names reconciled through holder-aliases.json first - two sources name the same power two ways and this dedups on the name, so without that it draws one polity twice. The macro tier the holder join makes possible. The four canonical macroTerritories are excluded because they exist as territories in their own right. Era travels per power and this is never current state. Rebuild with tools/build-holder-groupings.py.
